title: Fist Owned business is selling fudge
content: So I don't usually have dreams about an actual mall. However a few nights ago I had a dream that, I started a fudge business in a disserted mall with a giant pond throughout the mall. Me and a dream acquaintance went 50/50 on that business to rejuvenate the mall. We also decided to rent out the rest of the mall and do a farmers market, craft fair day rental for the holiday season. &#x200B; The next night I had a dream we had a major success with the holidays and were able to rent on a long-term basis 65% of the mall with long-term rentals. I bought the remaining 50% of the fudge business and me and my mall business partner decided to extend the mall by a few feet in the center to continue the day rentals.
